import React from "react"; import Card from "react-bootstrap/Card"; import { ImPointRight } from "react-icons/im"; function AboutCard() { return (

Hi Everyone, I am Anirudh Bojji from Hyderabad, India.
I am a network engineer working on cloud networking — routing systems, IPsec dataplanes, and multi-cloud infrastructure.
I hold a B.Tech in Computer Science from MVSR Engineering College, where my research work led to four peer-reviewed publications.

Apart from engineering, some activities I love:

  • Playing video games
  • Reading mythological novels
  • Travelling
); } export default AboutCard;
